modelAdapterDouble.method: Production ChatOllama and actual Ollama client HTTP serialization under httpx.MockTransport; synthetic provider responses.
modelAdapterDouble.verifiedSchema: FactSelection object has only factIds; 1-2 distinct IDs, restricted to the authorized catalog. No model prose, operational-link, citation-link or decision fields.
modelAdapterDouble.verifiedContext: Original question and applicable top policy are untrusted data; catalog entries contain fixed sentences, complete available links and sourceTools. The model supplies selection only.
modelAdapterDouble.insufficientPath: One synthetic planner response; no fact-selection request, no finding, unchanged conservative/actionable rule-owned response.
modelAdapterDouble.note: All successful calls/tokens in adapter tests are doubles, not live provider usage.

coverageEvidence.embeddingDoubles: RecordingEmbeddings returns simple fixed vectors to inspect tenant filtering/cache behavior; BrokenEmbeddings raises a controlled error to test explicit failure without lexical fallback.
coverageEvidence.actualUnavailableProvider: A real ChatOllama request to closed loopback port 1 verifies provider failure/no replay fallback. It is not successful model inference.

capturedRegressionSources: First six-case development CASE-1021 proposal reason
checks: Captured completed-case/unqualified-action wording remains rejected without rewriting in the unchanged final gate

workflowGuard.limitation: Targeted phrase checks are not general semantic entailment or paraphrase coverage.

checks: Scenario-independent whitelist over executed tools rather than free-text decision summaries
Refund requests and confirmations stay distinct; exact Java-derived money is formatted through integer arithmetic
Webhook event/payment identities and delivery/application counts are preserved
Unknown monetary fields remain unavailable rather than zero
Provider event occurrence order is distinct from webhook receipt order; inverse relationships use strict observed timestamps
Timestamp offsets compare as instants; ties or missing times do not invent strict order or processing timestamps
Refund confirmation is separate from explicit refund entry presence/count/IDs in the supplied ledger snapshot
UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE zero-candidate requests ask for status and conditional ledger/delivery verification, without inventing missing records
Insufficient retrieval query, summary, outcome and action are unchanged; current terminal status survives historical unavailable lookup
observedFactsProjection.status: Historical V5 projection helper regressions retained; not the V6 model input. V6 uses the service fact catalog.

checks: Exact selected service sentences and union of available evidence/policy links; no unselected facts or prose repair
Reject unknown, duplicate, too-many or empty selections and extra model-written prose/decision/link fields
Reject modified catalog wording/links/sourceTools even with recomputed hash by rebuilding from authorized outputs
Snapshot-as-of differs from success event occurrence; generic timeout is not labelled transport; CANCELLED is not labelled rejection
Exact named money fields use integer formatting and Java authoritative reconciliation when supplied
Refund confirmation differs from supplied-ledger membership; absence carries sourceTools and no invented evidence ID
Injected policy/record/title strings cannot write catalog text; selection relevance remains a limitation
Real API/LangGraph invalid-ID rejection retains original selection and two double-provider stages, with no accepted result
Validation resume does not regenerate selection; already completed historical prose result returns unchanged without relabelling
factSelectionAndCatalog.limits: Catalog/template correctness, source completeness, policy relevance and model selection usefulness remain separate from structural validity.

checks: Equal receipt instants, including timezone offsets, cannot fabricate order
Strictly earlier receipt groups provide at most one maximum-occurrence witness per record; nonadjacent ties do not hide inversions
Successful duplicate resolution requires one APPLIED and all remaining IGNORED_DUPLICATE records
Late earlier-occurring event in an inversion must be IGNORED_STALE, otherwise request evidence
strictDeliveryStateRules.fixtures: Small explicit unit records; no evaluation-label access. Root's actual HTTP adversarial run is separate.

checks: Normalized CAPTURE/PAYMENT_CAPTURED/SALE and REFUND/REFUND_POSTED aliases match visible count and total
Captures positive, refunds negative, FEE non-positive including zero; generic signed adjustments retained
Java count/capture/refund/net/currency/availability/payout/discrepancy must agree with immutable records and local sign validity
Contradictory authoritative values remain in audit reconciliation, invalidate money and request evidence without substitution
Refund/capture/settlement catalog money sentences cannot render invalid aggregate totals
Empty/whitespace/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE status cannot expose usable payout despite a numeric field
